handling_notes: grf_signals and acc_signals are ragged NumPy object arrays that require allow_pickle=True. NEVER unpickle on a normal host: convert once inside an isolated sandbox (or obtain a non-pickle export) before use. The 'both' file duplicates arms+noarms and is deliberately not listed (no duplicate data). Description says vGRF downsampled to 250 Hz with a 2000 ms window, but the stored grf_sampling_rate is 1000 and trial lengths vary; per-file counts are 334/329 vs documented 331/332. Treat metadata as unverified until conversion.
privacy_notes: Healthy sports-science students (45 M, 22 F); written consent and Swansea University ethics approval stated by depositors. Integer participant ids only; no names. Low re-identification risk.

source.citation: White et al. (2022) PLOS ONE accelerometer CMJ dataset; preprocessed Zenodo deposit 19136480 (2026)

title: Preprocessed accelerometer and vertical GRF data from countermovement jumps (derived from White et al. 2022, PLOS ONE)
